title: GTA 6 PS5 Price: Console Costs May Dampen Sales Boost
description: GTA 6 PS5 price worries: Circana says console costs could mute the sales boost GTA 6 brings to PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, according to GameSpot.

body.text: The GTA 6 PS5 price question is now a real talking point. According to GameSpot, Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19 and should lift console sales for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but high hardware prices could keep that bump smaller than many expect. For anyone planning to buy a console just for GTA 6, the cost matters as much as the game.
What Circana expects from GTA 6 console sales
GameSpot quotes Circana analyst Mat Piscatella, who says GTA 6 will "probably" boost PS5 and Xbox Series X|S sales. The catch is the recent price hikes on both platforms.
Piscatella's view, as relayed by GameSpot, is that someone who is hyped for GTA 6 and needs a new console may hesitate when they see how expensive hardware has become.
Why the GTA 6 PS5 price matters compared to GTA 5
GameSpot lays out the comparison with the last GTA generation. When GTA 5 launched in 2013, the average price paid for a new PS3 was $252, and for an Xbox 360 it was $232.
Adjusted for inflation, those figures would be roughly $363 for the PS3 and $334 for the Xbox 360 today. The current averages are much higher:

items: Xbox Series X|S: $663 average price paid

body.text: These are dollar figures from the report, so Indian buyers should treat them as a measure of the trend, not a local price list. The source does not give any India-specific pricing.
Take-Two's take on rising hardware costs

Earlier this year, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, whose company is publishing GTA 6, said, "The rising cost of hardware is not a good thing." Even so, GameSpot says he isn't worried about the effect on GTA 6, partly because he believes the game is good enough that people will find a way to pay for a console.
Zelnick also said cheaper hardware would be positive because more consoles would be in people's hands. He added that the world continues to move toward open systems, and that this will continue.

GTA 6 arrives on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, per GameSpot. New Zealand players get access first. The report doesn't list other regional start times, so check official Rockstar channels for your timing.

The real test is the first sales reports after launch. If Circana's early read holds, console numbers will rise but not as sharply as past blockbuster launches. Watch for official sales data, any further price moves from Sony or Microsoft, and whether Zelnick's confidence that fans will find the money proves right.

faqs.a: According to GameSpot, GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Players in New Zealand get to play first.

faqs.q: Will GTA 6 boost PS5 and Xbox sales?
faqs.a: Circana's Mat Piscatella told GameSpot there will "probably" be a boost, but recent price hikes could mute the uptick.

faqs.q: How much does a PS5 cost on average compared to the PS3 in the GTA 5 era?
faqs.a: GameSpot reports the average price paid for a new PS5 is $646, against $252 for a PS3 when GTA 5 launched in 2013, which is about $363 adjusted for inflation.

sources.title: GTA 6 Should Help Boost PS5 And Xbox Sales, But Their Astronomical Prices Could Hurt
